name: Mochigase Sudare
source: On the outside she is a very capable woman, but at home she becomes very lazy. Loves alcohol, will find any opportunity to throw a party for the sole intent on drinking to her heart's content. Thinks love and sexual relationships are an illusion and loves debating about this issue, but she is in fact a virgin.
